title: Compliance Orchestration Hub — priority heuristic and evidence bundler
creator: Nina Morales
description: Build a Compliance Orchestration Hub that centralizes incoming enterprise security & compliance requests (SOC2/ISO, HIPAA, GDPR/DPA, vendor questionnaires) and applies a deterministic priority heuristic to route tickets, surface required evidence, and produce a pre-populated evidence bundle for review. The hub will integrate with support portals, account metadata, and our Confluence/GDrive docs to reduce manual triage overhead while preserving human-in-the-loop review for high-risk decisions. Key goals: reduce average triage time for enterprise questionnaire requests, increase SLA compliance for P0/P1 security asks, and reduce reviewer effort by providing evidence suggestions and mapping to contractual clauses.
acceptance_criteria: Incoming security/compliance requests are auto-classified into initial priority lanes (P0/P1/P2) with a clear confidence score
System suggests an evidence bundle (links + doc snippets) for >= 70% of questionnaire items for enterprise accounts
Role-based routing sends high-confidence P0/P1 tickets to Security Ops and medium-confidence to PM/SE queues
Dashboards show triage time reduction >= 35% in pilot accounts after launch
All automation decisions are logged with audit trail and human override option

decisions: MVP will include LLM-assisted classification but require >0.7 confidence for full automation; lower confidence paths surface suggestions only
Evidence bundler will produce a GDrive folder manifest and a short rationale snippet per suggested doc to aid reviewer speed
Do not auto-respond to customers in MVP; always require human sign-off for outbound answers to enterprise questionnaires
tradeoffs: Automation vs. accuracy: aggressive automation saves ops time but increases risk of incorrect legal/evidence mapping; mitigated by confidence thresholds and manual overrides
Data residency: pulling document snippets from GDrive increases speed but raises access control complexity; solved by role-based fetch tokens and audit logs
LLM privacy: using model-assisted classification requires scrubbed training examples and audit logs to avoid exposing customer PII to internal models
metrics: Primary: Mean time to triage (hours) — target -35% for pilot accounts
Secondary: Percentage of tickets auto-routed without manual adjustment — target 50% within 3 months
Safety: Manual override rate for P0/P1 automation — target < 15%
